content.text: Submitted. The proposal now consists of a single concise insertion of Section 12.6.6 (anchored after the final body paragraph of Section 12.6) carrying the complete preferred position — expiry-or-termination trigger, up to six (6) months of Harpoon transition assistance at Harpoon's then-current rates, return of Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination in a standard machine-readable format, and deletion with written certification thereafter. The prior rewrite of Section 12.6.1(c), the request gates, the "at AbbVie's cost" basis, and the extraneous retention and wind-down boilerplate were removed, and all official checks and the minimality gate now pass.
